data.summary:
* Fixed WORKER_INFRA_FAILURE regression where `classifyAttempt` searched raw `getWorkerLogs()` for `[claude]`/`[tool]` prefixes that are only added downstream by `claude-log-processor.ts`, causing every successful post-#1913 attempt to be mis-classified as `empty_transcript`.
  * Broadened classifier to detect stream-JSON `system/init` and `assistant`/`tool_use` events (the shapes that actually appear in raw logs) and added a short-circuit on successful `TaskResult.prUrl`; kept the legacy prefix checks as belt-and-suspenders.
  * TDD: committed a red integration test with a realistic raw-stream fixture (1 commit), then the stream-JSON signal broadening (1 commit), then the `prUrl` short-circuit with `exactOptional`-safe plumbing through `task-dispatcher.ts` (1 commit), then review-fix commit tightening the input type and covering null/empty/tool_use branches (1 commit) plus a prettier-format commit.
  * Tests: 6 new tests in `classify-attempt.test.ts` (now 15 total) + new `classify-attempt-integration.test.ts`; full `pnpm run ci:tracked` green (15517 tests).
  * Flagged `getLast50ClaudeLines` in `completion-verifier/transcript.ts:30` as the same pattern (non-blocking, webhook summary only) for a scoped follow-up PR, per plan §5; documented in PR body and Linear comment.
